description: Cenotaph: standalone Morphe patches for Instagram. Chat wallpaper, chat tint, colour map, bubble corners, local font, DM streaks, theme picker, settings app and a Piko settings row. Two real anchors: the thread anchor hooks Instagram's DM root-view method, and the wallpaper hook replaces the bitmap in the app's own thread background setter. Every feature patch registers itself separately. Built for Instagram 447.0.0.55.81 (385311895).
